create_BackgroundTask_subclass: create a subclass of BackgroundTask that overrides the async run method to collect metrics every 60 seconds
run_BackgroundTask_run: run the BackgroundTask async run coroutine in the pipeline event loop and handle CancelledError for cleanup
use_BackgroundTaskFactory: use a BackgroundTaskFactory callable to create BackgroundTask instances that run alongside pipeline stages
get_default_background_tasks: get the default background task factories currently set for the pipeline engine or None if not configured
set_default_background_tasks: set the default background task factories globally so all pipelines use them by default
